# POSIX Extended Regular Expressions.
#
# Modern unescaped convention — `(`, `)` group; `|` alternates; `+`,
# `?` quantify; `{n,m}` bounded. Backslash now ESCAPES specials to
# literal meaning (`\(` literal paren, `\|` literal pipe, `\+`
# literal plus). Backreferences `\1`-`\9` are POSIX-2008+.
#
# GNU extensions accepted: `\b`/`\B`, `\<`/`\>`, `\d`/`\w`/`\s` etc.
# POSIX character classes `[[:alpha:]]` work the same as in BRE.

ere = ereAlternation

ereAlternation = ereSequence + (ereAltTail)*
ereAltTail     = ereAltSep + ereSequence
ereAltSep      = "|"

ereSequence = (ereAtomQ)*

ereAtomQ = ereAtom + ereQuantSuffix?

ereAtom = ereGroup
        | ereCharClass
        | ereAnchorStart
        | ereAnchorEnd
        | ereDot
        | ereEscapedAtom
        | ereLiteralChar

ereGroup      = ereGroupOpen + ereAlternation + ereGroupClose
ereGroupOpen  = "("
ereGroupClose = ")"

# Same char-class regex shape as BRE. POSIX-class alternative listed
# first so `[[:alpha:]]` matches through both `]`s.
ereCharClass = /\[\^?\]?(?:\[:[a-z]+:\]|\\.|[^\]])*\]/

ereAnchorStart = "^"
ereAnchorEnd   = "$"
ereDot         = "."

ereEscapedAtom = ereBackref
               | ereWordBoundaryAlias
               | ereWordBoundary
               | ereNonWordBoundary
               | ereClassDigit
               | ereClassWord
               | ereClassSpace
               | ereClassNotDigit
               | ereClassNotWord
               | ereClassNotSpace
               | ereControlEscape
               | ereHexEscape
               | ereUnicodeEscape
               | ereLiteralEscape

ereBackref           = /\\[1-9]/
ereWordBoundaryAlias = /\\[<>]/
ereWordBoundary      = /\\b/
ereNonWordBoundary   = /\\B/
ereClassDigit        = /\\d/
ereClassNotDigit     = /\\D/
ereClassWord         = /\\w/
ereClassNotWord      = /\\W/
ereClassSpace        = /\\s/
ereClassNotSpace     = /\\S/
ereControlEscape     = /\\[ntrfv0]/
ereHexEscape         = /\\x[0-9a-fA-F][0-9a-fA-F]/
ereUnicodeEscape     = /\\u[0-9a-fA-F]{4}/
# Catch-all `\X` for any X not already handled. Used by the model to
# escape ERE metacharacters back to literals (e.g. `\(` to get a
# literal paren).
ereLiteralEscape = /\\[^bBdDwWsSntrfv0xu1-9]/

# Literal char: anything that isn't an unescaped metacharacter or `\`.
ereLiteralChar = /[^.\\\[\^$()|+*?{}]/

# Order matters: try `{n,m}` first (longer match) before the bare
# operators.
ereQuantSuffix = ereBraceQuant
               | ereStarQ
               | erePlusQ
               | ereQuestionQ

ereStarQ      = /\*\??/
erePlusQ      = /\+\??/
ereQuestionQ  = /\?\??/
ereBraceQuant = /\{[0-9]+(?:,[0-9]*)?\}\??/
